subject: Runtime / Kernel squad: delegated approval for two IC hires and offer bands
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime / Kernel squad: delegated approval for two IC hires and offer bands

Team —

Summary: requesting delegation to extend offers for two critical hires on the kernel/perf side: 1x Senior Runtime Engineer (latency focus) and 1x Kernel Performance Engineer (CUDA/attention kernels). Recruiting has two near-offer candidates; we need confirmation on max offer envelopes and any constraints before I give final sign instructions.

Why now: both candidates are ramp-ready and have completed final interviews. Delaying by another review cycle (~1 week) risks losing both. The positions align with our Q3 throughput capacity plan (see attached packet).

Proposed slots and comp guidance (draft):
- Senior Runtime Engineer (Level: Sr IC / Band R5): base $170k–$190k, target total comp with equity and bonus $225k–$260k.
- Kernel Performance Engineer (Level: Sr/Staff crossover / Band R5+): base $185k–$205k, target total comp $240k–$280k.

Requests:
1) Kimberly / Marcus: delegation to me to sign off final offers within the band ceilings above (I will not exceed the stated maxima).
2) Monica: please confirm People Ops OK on the equity strike/vesting cadence and that we can use the attached offer template.
3) Recruiting (cc'ed externally): prepare DocuSign-ready packets with the max amounts in the template; hold until I confirm.

Attachments: headcount_packet_kernel_squad_v1.pdf (application/pdf) — includes role writeups, comp benchmarking, business justification, and candidate shortlist.

If I don't hear objections by EOD Monday (5/21), I'll proceed to extend verbal offers and send DocuSign links for signatures.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Staff Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference


From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime / Kernel squad: delegated approval for two IC hires and offer bands

Diego —

Thanks for the clear packet and the fast follow. I support delegating final sign-off to you with the following constraints:

- Do not exceed $205k base for either role without prior written approval from me.
- For the Kernel Performance Engineer, cap sign-on equity to 0.45% for external candidates unless Monica confirms an exception.
- Any counter that would push total cash above the upper target must come back to me.

Monica, please confirm People Ops is fine with the 0.45% equity cap and the proposed vesting schedule in the packet. Marcus, flag any product dependencies we should note in the onboarding plan.

If these are acceptable, Diego, you have my delegation to proceed with offers through Recruiting once Monica greenlights the equity. Please record the hires in HR-REQ-2028-0452.

-Kimberly

People Ops confirms the following:
- 0.45% equity cap for the Kernel Performance Engineer is acceptable for external hires given level and market benchmarks.
- Vesting schedule: standard 4 years with 1-year cliff.
- We will use the provided offer_template_senior_runtime.docx but will swap the appendix to include localized benefits for the candidate's state.

Ellen / team —

Thanks. We have delegation to proceed with offers under the constraints Kimberly outlined (not to exceed $205k base; 0.45% equity cap for kernel role). Please prepare two DocuSign packets:

1) Senior Runtime Engineer — base at candidate's target within $170k–$190k, standard vesting.
2) Kernel Performance Engineer — base at candidate's target within $185k–$205k, equity capped at 0.45%.

Please hold verbal offers until I confirm totals (I will call each candidate today). Route final packets to hr-approvals@redwood.com for sign-off. Once HR stamps, send DocuSign links to candidates and cc me.

Attach any redline requests to this thread.

Diego
